newsitem.title: UK: LME people-Exchange compliance officer leaving.
newsitem.headline: LME people-Exchange compliance officer leaving.

text.p: Chris Savage, compliance officer at the London Metal Exchange (LME), has resigned to take up employment at another organisation, the LME said.
In a notice, the LME said Savage had already left the LME's compliance department, but continues until May 9 with the Regulatory Issues Implementation Sub-Committee.
This commmittee's work comprises mainly of developing implementation plans in response to the SIB's review of the metals markets.
